admission.justification: Rail retention, message switching, counted loads and burst coalescing live in different files across shell, frame component, controller and chat panel; no member alone promises the one-loaded-chat lifetime, so the guarantee needs the joint reading.

guarantee: The Operations right rail retains one DocumentChat/frame after first activation and toggles visibility, not mount; hidden chat remains out of keyboard/accessibility reach. Known no-agent selections hide behind the bound launcher, while unknown discovery keeps the application visible and held under a named wait. Open-capable ready changes steer by message; responsive late answers do not reload. A load readiness wait holds the latest target for ready/pong; ping silence permits fallback. Retry/host return and explicitly unsupported open capability are separate URL-load paths. Each actual document load increments generation once; unavailable nonloading bursts coalesce to their latest target.
title: One loaded sidebar chat switches by message and hides without unloading
